title: Blood Donation Camp
summary: The Rotary Club of Bombay Powai successfully conducted a Blood Donation Camp in association with Samarpan Blood Centre.
description:
The Rotary Club of Bombay Powai successfully conducted a Blood Donation Camp in association with Samarpan Blood Centre. The camp was organised to support 140 Thalassemia children, who collectively require nearly 400 units of blood every month.
We are happy to share that 25 donors came forward to donate blood. 11 donors could donate blood, contributing to this vital cause and helping support children who depend on regular blood transfusions. Thanks to Rtn. Alpana Mansukhani, Rtn Pradeep Srivastava, Rtn Priyanka Banerjee, Rtn Naval Khanna who gave their time, support and encouragement to make this initiative a success.
location: Hiranandani Foundation International School, Powai., Mumbai, Maharashtra
